review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: PuntoUP Professional Recruitment is looking for a Network Engineer on behalf of a company active in cloud and data center services. The role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data center network infrastructure, working with technologies such as Cisco and Fortinet. If you have solid networking expertise and enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems, we'd like to hear from you. Location: Bucharest, Romania Main Purpose of the Job: The Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the data center network infrastructure, including Cisco and Fortinet technologies. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of network technologies and protocols, along with experience designing and implementing complex networks. The role requires problem-solving ability, strong communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams. Job Profile: Design, implement, and maintain the network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, and other network devices from various vendors (Cisco, Fortinet, Citrix, Brocade). Maintain the network and perform upgrades, install patches, hotfixes, and security configurations. Work within established Configuration Management and Change Management policies. Provide technical network support, including traffic analysis and identification and resolution of performance issues; deliver L2/L3 technical assistance and troubleshooting in line with SLA requirements. Perform root-cause analysis and recommend solutions and optimizations. Communicate effectively with technology vendors and third parties (clients, partners) to resolve issues. Monitor and analyze network availability and performance, recommending optimizations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration between network infrastructure and other systems. Develop and maintain network infrastructure documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and procedures. Evaluate new networking technologies and make adoption recommendations. Work with security teams to implement security solutions, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, anti-ransomware, encryption, etc. Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans for the network infrastructure. Provide training and guidance to other team members. Provide on-call support outside regular working hours. Candidate Profile: University degree, preferably in a technical, IT, or related field. Advanced English, written and spoken. Minimum 4 years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-level network infrastructure. Experience designing and implementing complex networks using Cisco, Fortinet, Citrix, Checkpoint, and other relevant technologies. Solid knowledge of networking technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, QoS, VRF, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, STP, VPN, IPSEC, HSRP, VRRP, LACP). Relevant certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Citrix Certified Expert - Networking (CCE-N), etc. are an advantage. Knowledge of Linux is an advantage. Hands-on experience with network monitoring, diagnostic, and analysis tools (SNMP-based monitoring, NetFlow, Nagios, Zabbix). Experience with network automation and scripting using tools such as Ansible or PowerShell is an advantage. Public cloud knowledge (Microsoft Azure, AWS) is an advantage. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams. Strong communication skills, able to engage effectively with the team, clients, and colleagues from other departments. High level of energy and enthusiasm to approach projects and team collaboration with a proactive, positive attitude. Benefits: Competitive net salary package. International work environment. Continuous professional and technical development. Private health care package. Lunch tickets. All candidates who meet the above qualifications are warmly encouraged to submit their applications online. We will reach out exclusively to those who are best suited for the role within a maximum of two weeks. For other job opportunities, visit our website at www.puntoup.com and upload your CV to our database to remain eligible for both current and future positions. All applications are handled with the utmost confidentiality. By submitting your personal data via email to any address ending in “www.puntoup.com” or “www.puntoup.ro,” through social media platforms (such as Facebook, LinkedIn), or by applying via an online job portal, you provide explicit consent for PuntoUP and its affiliated companies to process your data. For more information, please refer to our data processing policy. Should you have any concerns regarding your personal data, kindly contact dataprotection@puntoup.com.

review_candidates.title: Field Engineer (On Site)
review_candidates.description: *Must live in the Knoxville, TN area— This is an onsite position. *  Enable Resource Group is seeking a mission-minded Field Engineer to join our growing team!   Since 2000, Enable Ministry Partners, a division of Enable Resource Group, has managed and supported IT solutions for hundreds of churches across the country. By helping our church clients effectively employ technology in ministry efforts, they are better able to steward their resources toward Kingdom work in local communities and around the world. As we provide technology strategy plans, AI consulting, project management, help desk support, onsite assistance, technology audits and other services, our church staffs are freed up to focus on ministry, worship, and growing in love for God and others. At Enable, we're in more than just the IT business; we’re in the people and relationship business, with a mission to Change Lives by Serving Those Who Serve.   As a Field Engineer, you will be responsible for providing both onsite and remote IT support directly to Enable clients. While resolving a wide range of issues, you will exercise thoughtful planning, careful execution, and effective teamwork, with a priority on building relationships. You should bring an impressive technical/networking competency, along with skills of tactful communication and excellent time and project management. Because of a consistent onsite presence, your role requires representing Enable in a highly professional and relational manner as you troubleshoot client IT issues and conduct projects.   Key Responsibilities:  Providing on-site technical support to clients and ensuring reliable technology resolutions. Installing, configuring, and maintaining hardware and software systems within various environments. Building client relationships through the use of active listening and empathetic behavior. Tailoring explanations of complex technical concepts to meet clients where they are, empowering them by making those concepts easily understandable for all skill levels.  Required Skills:  3+ years in an IT support role troubleshooting Tier II – Tier III tickets   Proficient technical skills in the following areas:   Current experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications   Proven knowledge with creating and managing users, groups, and objects within Active Directory and/or Entra ID  Working knowledge of electronic ticketing systems  Windows and macOS operating systems support   IT infrastructure knowledge and expertise with respect to:   Basic networking concepts such as DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP and IP routing   LAN & WAN architecture and troubleshooting   Windows server management   Virtualization (Hyper-V or similar)  Working knowledge and experience with:   Computer setup and configuration of Mac and PC  Microsoft 365 administration   Remote administration concepts and tools   Disaster recovery and backup technology   Active Directory, security and distribution groups, and group policy   Windows-based print servers   Ability to undergo and pass a background check in accordance with state and federal laws Valid drivers’ license and reliable transportation Ability to lift at least 50 lbs.   Preferred Skills:  Firewall configuration and troubleshooting  Enterprise Wi-Fi solutions   Enterprise network switches   Network configuration: VLAN, QoS, LAG  Process/task automation solutions in business or other environments  Microsoft Azure  Google Workspace administration  Experience with managed services tools from vendors such as ConnectWise, Datto/Kaseya, etc.   Professional certifications: A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft certifications, etc.  A bachelor's degree in a related area of study  At Enable, we put people and relationships first. One way we accomplish this is by providing comprehensive benefits that enhance the Enable experience.  Benefits:  Fantastic company culture Great work/life balance Competitive salary Competitive health benefits 3 weeks of PTO & major holidays 401k with a match Growth opportunities And much more!  To find out more information about Enable and our mission, visit our website at https://enableministry.com/   By joining our team, you have an outlet to contribute your professional skills and immediately become part of a life-changing impact. We can't wait to meet you!

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: WELCOME TO OLX We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe , smart , and environmentally responsible . We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust. Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors. About The Role Join OLX and see how far you can go. We are looking for a mid-level Network Engineer for the Global BIT Infrastructure team. The infrastructure team’s mission is to manage business-critical global networks and applications at scale. We are supporting internal tools & systems that everybody at OLX is using. The Network Engineer contributes to the stability, scalability, and continuous improvement of OLX's global corporate network. Working within the BIT Infrastructure team, this role takes ownership of key network domains while collaborating with both junior and senior engineers. The Network Engineer bridges day-to-day operations with longer-term improvement initiatives, playing an active role in shaping reliable, secure, and efficient network solutions that support OLX's operations across 10 countries. Our long-term vision is to embrace cloud networking capabilities and network infrastructure automation. What You Will Be Doing Own the design, implementation, and maintenance of LAN/WAN infrastructure across global office locations, ensuring high availability and performance. Manage the security of network services and systems, including firewalls, VPNs, and access controls, to protect OLX's corporate environment. Identify and troubleshoot complex network problems - including WiFi, VPN, and WAN issues - conducting root-cause analysis and driving resolution. Monitor network health proactively, identifying potential threats, analysing anomalies, and leading the response to network incidents. Participate in the change management process for network infrastructure and applications, assessing the security and operational impact of proposed changes. Maintain and enforce security compliance standards across all network devices and tools, identifying gaps and proposing remediation. Produce and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, and project documentation. Drive automation initiatives to improve the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of network operations, leveraging scripting and infrastructure-as-code tooling. Act as a point of reference for junior engineers, providing guidance and supporting their technical development. Collaborate with cross-functional teams - including IT Operations, Security, Infrastructure, and Engineering - to deliver integrated and reliable solutions. Participate in on-call rotations and support schedules, taking ownership of escalated network issues when required. What Are We Looking For Solid hands-on network engineering experience with enterprise office network setup, including working experience with Meraki and Cisco stack Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, BGP, VLANs/Spanning Tree, firewalls, routing) Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, or Bash); experience with Terraform/Ansible and AWS networking capabilities is a plus Understanding of CI/CD tools (Gitlab CI/CD, GitHub Actions); familiarity with ITIL practices and ITSM tools (Jira, ServiceNow) is desirable. Familiarity with AI-assisted tooling and low-code/no-code automation platforms. Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across systems and environments. Experience contributing to or leading automation and process improvement projects. Clear and effective communicator, able to produce high-quality technical documentation and engage confidently with stakeholders. Collaborative and dependable team member, capable of supporting junior colleagues and working across disciplines. Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong attention to detail and a continuous improvement attitude. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and evolving technical environment. Our Hiring Process Recruiter Interview Technical Interview Hiring Manager Interview Our Benefits Contract of employment (we're not offering B2B). Monthly salary and an annual bonus (15%) Training and conference budget A benefits package with 300 points on the Mybenefit platform per month (private medical care provided by Luxmed, Ask Henry services, and much more) 100% remote work (as well as the possibility of working from our office in Poznan) Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us! OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement .

review_candidates.description: Cloud & Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Role Overview We are looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to build, operate, automate, and continuously improve highly available cloud-native infrastructure powering SaaS platform. You will work across public cloud, Kubernetes, compute, storage, networking, observability, and infrastructure automation - with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, security, and reducing manual operations. The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure fundamentals with a software engineering and automation mindset - someone who proactively identifies operational issues and engineers permanent solutions rather than relying on repetitive manual processes. Key Responsibilities Cloud & Infrastructure Operations: Design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot cloud-native infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP - including compute, storage, networking, and containers. Handle provisioning, upgrades, patching, and capacity management; resolve connectivity, DNS, and load-balancing issues. Site Reliability Engineering: Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, monitor for reliability risks, and drive incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. Automate away recurring operational work and improve system resilience through redundancy and automated recovery. Kubernetes & Microservices: Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized microservices on Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE), including ingress, storage, secrets, and cluster health. Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Automate provisioning and operational workflows with Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Bash; build reusable IaC modules integrated into CI, CD. Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, CloudWatch, etc.) with meaningful dashboards and low-noise alerting. Networking & Security: Troubleshoot cloud networking (VPC, VNet, DNS, VPN, firewalls, load balancers); apply IAM, RBAC, secrets, and least-privilege security practices. Incident & Production Support: Participate in on-call rotations, own incidents end-to-end, and maintain runbooks and automated remediation procedures. Cost & Performance Optimization: Identify underutilized resources and support FinOps initiatives (rightsizing, scheduling, lifecycle management) while balancing cost with reliability. Required Skills Strong hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud - AWS, Azure, or GCP. Solid understanding of Linux administration and infrastructure fundamentals. Experience with Kubernetes and containerized microservices. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and, or Ansible). Strong automation, scripting skills in Python and Bash (PowerShell a plus). Good understanding of networking, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and cloud routing. Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms. Understanding of CI, CD, Git, APIs, and modern DevOps practices. Experience troubleshooting distributed production environments. Understanding of security, IAM, RBAC, secrets, certificates, and infrastructure security. Familiarity with database operations a plus. Preferred Skills Experience & Qualifications Experience operating hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud environments. Experience with VMware, Nutanix, OpenShift, or similar private-cloud technologies. Experience building automated remediation or self-healing workflows. Familiarity with AIOps, event correlation, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted operations. Understanding of FinOps and cloud cost optimization. Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow. Cloud, Kubernetes, Linux, or Terraform certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) are a strong plus. SRE Mindset Automate before repeating, and engineer permanent fixes instead of resolving the same incident twice. Treat infrastructure and operational configuration as code. Design for failure and recovery, and measure reliability using data. Build reusable automation and operational standards. Reduce operational toil and unnecessary tickets. Continuously improve reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with minimum of 70%. SRE Engineer - 2–6 years of relevant Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps, SRE experience. Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are a strong plus. Roles and responsibilities Design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot cloud-native infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Handle provisioning, upgrades, patching, and capacity management. Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, monitor for reliability risks, and drive incident response. Automate away recurring operational work. Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized microservices on Kubernetes. Automate provisioning and operational workflows with Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Bash. Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting. Troubleshoot cloud networking and apply security practices. Participate in on-call rotations and own incidents end-to-end. Identify underutilized resources and support FinOps initiatives. Experience and education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with minimum of 70% Location Remote

Our industry-leading technology organization is looking for a passionate, quality-minded individual to drive innovation along with a forward-thinking team. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Build, optimize, and manage cloud-native systems such as Kubernetes clusters and cloud resources Document, maintain, improve, and validate work products Participate in agile development process as part of a scrum team including planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement Coordinate and participate in cyber security reviews Coordinate and participate in architecture reviews Work with global team to execute project initiatives Who You Are: You consistently build and deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations. You readily adopt innovations to enhance work processes to manage complexity, you acquire data from diverse contributors and stakeholders to effectively navigate problems and actively cultivate innovation by encouraging the expression of diverse ideas and opinions. You seize new opportunities by taking constructive steps to overcome obstacles. You maintain progress and ensure work aligns with objectives. You foster collaboration to achieve common goals while relating comfortably across various levels, functions, cultures, and geography. For This Role, You Will Need: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related A minimum of five (5) years experience with large-scale infrastructure systems in a production environment Proficiency in modern programming and scripting languages such as Go, Python, Bash, C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or others. Proficiency with Kubernetes (cluster lifecycle, networking, upgrades) and containerization technologies like Docker. Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform. Experience working within an Agile development framework. Legal authorization to work in the United States - Sponsorship will not be provided for this role Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: Advanced training in cloud services and configuration management (Azure, AWS, GCP). Strong understanding of network architecture and security protocols. Experience optimizing performance and scalability in infrastructure systems. Knowledgeable in service discovery and load-balancing technologies. Experience with GitOps tools, such as Argo CD or Flux. Proficiency in DevSecOps CI/CD automation environments. Expertise in backup and disaster recovery strategies within a cloud setting. Experience with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and know that to do your best you must have flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide, a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, profit sharing retirement, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave. About Us WHY EMERSON Our Commitment to Our People At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration. We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together. Work Authorization Emerson will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1(including those with OPT or CPT) , H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. Equal Opportunity Employer Emerson is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com . About Emerson Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability. With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety. We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go! No calls or agencies please.

review_candidates.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Infrastructure Specialist (Europe/Middle East)
review_candidates.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About North North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications. Why This Role? This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Our esteemed clients include industry leaders like RBC, Dell, and LG CNS. We are seeking engineers who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI. In This Role, You Will Lead end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout. Partner with enterprise IT teams to assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices. Experiment at a high velocity and with a high level of quality to engage our customers and ultimately deliver solutions that exceed their expectations Design and implement deployment strategies tailored to client needs, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security standards. Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related technical issues, providing timely solutions to minimize downtime. You May Be a Good Fit If You have experience with and enjoy working directly with customers You have experience deploying enterprise software in private/hybrid cloud environments You have proven experience administering production Kubernetes clusters and expertise with Helm Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Git for version control You have strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), networking, and virtualization You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How And Where We Work Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

review_candidates.title: Responsable d'Équipe Opérations Réseaux H/F
review_candidates.description: Nous recherchons, pour notre client, un RESPONSABLE D'EQUIPE OPERATION RESEAUX (H/F). Le Responsable d'équipe Opérations Réseaux pilote le maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) de l'infrastructure réseau et veille à la qualité de service délivrée aux utilisateurs. Il est garant du respect des SLA , de la performance des services et de la continuité d'activité. À ce titre, il supervise l'activité opérationnelle, pilote les situations critiques et s'assure de la mise en oeuvre des plans d'amélioration. En parallèle, il accompagne et développe les compétences de son équipe, favorise la montée en autonomie des collaborateurs et contribue à leur performance et à leur évolution professionnelle. Principales responsabilités : 👥 Management et développement des talents Réaliser les entretiens annuels et assurer le suivi des plans de développement individuels (PDI). Fixer les objectifs individuels et collectifs, définir les priorités et assurer leur suivi. Animer les rituels d'équipe et favoriser la collaboration, la communication et la cohésion. Identifier les besoins en formation et accompagner la montée en compétences techniques et fonctionnelles. Accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur évolution professionnelle et leur montée en autonomie. ⚙️ Pilotage opérationnel et qualité de service Superviser le traitement des incidents critiques et coordonner les actions nécessaires au rétablissement du service. Piloter l'analyse et la résolution des problèmes récurrents afin d'en réduire durablement l'impact. Garantir le respect des processus et bonnes pratiques ITIL . Veiller à la disponibilité, la stabilité et la performance de l'infrastructure réseau. Suivre et analyser les KPIs opérationnels et mettre en place les actions correctives nécessaires. Piloter les prestations des partenaires et fournisseurs afin de garantir la qualité des services et la continuité d'activité. Veiller au respect des engagements contractuels et des niveaux de service (SLA). 📈 Amélioration continue et transformation Analyser les tendances d'incidentologie et identifier les axes d'amélioration. Définir et piloter des plans d'action visant à réduire les incidents et améliorer la qualité de service. Identifier les opportunités d'optimisation et d'automatisation des activités opérationnelles. Proposer et accompagner la mise en oeuvre d'évolutions technologiques et organisationnelles. Contribuer à la réduction de la dette technique et à l'optimisation des ressources. Veiller au respect des standards de sécurité, des règles de gouvernance et des politiques de la DSI sur l'ensemble du périmètre réseau. Indicateurs de performance (KPIs) La performance du poste sera notamment évaluée au regard des indicateurs suivants : Disponibilité et stabilité : taux de disponibilité du réseau et respect des SLA. Incidentologie : diminution des incidents récurrents et amélioration du MTTR (Mean Time To Repair). Développement des compétences : suivi et complétude des PDI, progression des compétences et montée en autonomie des collaborateurs. Performance opérationnelle : respect des budgets OPEX/CAPEX et des engagements de livraison. Le profil recherché Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en administration systèmes et réseaux et êtes capable d’intervenir en autonomie sur des environnements de production. Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez prioriser les incidents et travailler en collaboration avec différentes équipes techniques. Vous appréciez les environnements techniques variés et souhaitez évoluer dans un contexte dynamique et structuré. Techniquement, vous êtes capable d’intervenir sur les technologies suivantes : Systèmes : VMware Veeam Windows Server Linux Réseaux : Aruba (LAN / WIFI) Une bonne capacité d’analyse, un esprit d’équipe et un sens du service développé seront des atouts essentiels pour réussir sur ce poste. Bienvenue chez SYS TÉLÉCOMS Située à Villeneuve d’Ascq, SYS TELECOMS est une société à taille humaine qui a pour mission d’accompagner les entreprises dans la maîtrise des infrastructures et des projets IT. Depuis plus de 10 ans, nous sommes présents auprès de nos clients, de l’analyse, de l’existant jusqu’à la mise en œuvre de solutions nouvelles. Nous articulons nos efforts dans 5 grands domaines : L’audit et le déploiement L’infogérance IT L’expertise technique L’expertise projet Le conseil Nos équipes composées de techniciens, d’ingénieurs et de chefs de projet formés et certifiés travaillent de concert dans l’objectif d’offrir des prestations de qualité tout en développant leurs compétences. Intégrer SYS TELECOMS c’est rejoindre une société qui a la conviction, que c’est en donnant les moyens et en accompagnant les individus, qu’ils peuvent exprimer leurs pleins potentiels. Nous croyons aux besoins d’épanouissement professionnel de nos collaborateurs, à la force du collectif et à l’importance des conditions de travail. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents chaque jour auprès de nos collaborateurs et auprès de nos clients pour relever de nouveaux défis.

review_candidates.title: Junior IT Administrator, EMEA
review_candidates.description: About Dash0 Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in. Dash0 is an OpenTelemetry-native observability platform growing fast, and the infrastructure that keeps our team operational needs to be as reliable as the product we build. As our Junior IT Administrator, you'll own the full device and access lifecycle — from a new hire's first laptop to an employee's final offboarding — and build the systems that make it repeatable at scale. This role exists because we've outgrown ad-hoc IT. We need someone who takes genuine ownership: provisioning accounts, enforcing endpoint security, maintaining audit-ready records, and keeping our SaaS stack under control. You'll work closely with our Head of Security and People Ops team, but the systems work is yours to run. It's a foundational role with real scope. The processes you put in place today will scale with the company for years. What You'll Do Provision and de-provision accounts across our SaaS stack for every new hire and departure, keeping onboarding repeatable and offboarding complete. Manage the full device lifecycle: hardware ordering, MDM enrollment, international logistics, maintenance, and responsible recycling at end-of-life. Enforce endpoint security policies, including disk encryption, activation lock, and device compliance checks, coordinating with our Head of Security to keep standards current. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of who has access to what — catching and resolving discrepancies in serial numbers, license counts, and access logs before they become compliance issues. Execute end-to-end offboarding by revoking access across all systems, coordinating hardware retrieval, and ensuring nothing slips through. Manage vendor relationships and contracts for IT services and hardware insurance, including invoice auditing and service forecasting. Support employees across time zones with clear, prompt communication on IT issues, hardware needs, and access requests. What You Bring 0–2 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, or a technical helpdesk role. Hands-on comfort with device management tools and the Google Workspace admin console, including user and group management. A working understanding of endpoint security concepts — disk encryption, activation lock, device compliance policies, and why they matter in a security-conscious environment. Strong attention to detail: you notice when a serial number, license count, or access log doesn't add up, and you follow through until it does. Clear written English and ease coordinating across time zones with employees, vendors, and internal teams. The ability to manage many concurrent tickets and threads without losing track of any of them — you're organized and self-directed. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with a specific MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji, Fleet, or Intune. Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001-style access review and audit processes. Basic scripting skills for automating repetitive provisioning or reporting tasks. Experience in a high-growth startup environment. Why Dash0 This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel and Cherry Ventures and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B — and we're just getting started. If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real and your impact is visible from day one — this is it. What we offer: Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation — you'll own part of what you're building Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich €60/month phone & internet allowance Location-specific benefits Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset Clear path for career growth and development Direct access to founders and leadership

review_candidates.title: 10659 – Executive Principal, Infrastructure Operations
review_candidates.description: 10659 – Executive Principal, Infrastructure Operations Location: Irvine, CA 92614 (5-days on-site) Company Overview: Hyundai Autoever America (HAEA) is the dynamic IT powerhouse behind Hyundai Motor Corporation, a Fortune 500 global leader in the automotive industry. As a key affiliate, we provide cutting-edge IT services and Managed Services Provider support to top brands including Kia, Genesis, Hyundai Translead, Hyundai Mobis, Hyundai Capital, and Glovis. HAEA offers a truly global and collaborative environment. Here, you’ll drive innovation, boost operational efficiency, and help shape the future of mobility for the Hyundai Motor Group. At HAEA, we understand that IT is the cornerstone of today’s fast-evolving digital world. By uniting all IT resources under one roof, we deliver consistent, top-quality solutions while serving as the crucial information link between Hyundai’s Global Headquarters and North American operations. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make a real impact at a world-class company, Hyundai AutoEver America is the place to grow your career. Join us and be part of the transformation that’s driving the future of automotive innovation. Website: http://www.haeaus.com What you will be doing : We are in search of an Executive Principal, Infrastructure Operations to work 5-days on-site at our corporate headquarters in Irvine, CA. The selected candidate will be the senior executive accountable for end‑to‑end enterprise infrastructure operations, including data centers, networks, cloud and hybrid platforms, workplace services, and core platform reliability. This role owns day‑to‑day run operations, service stability, operational risk, and continuous improvement across infrastructure domains—executed primarily through internal operations teams, with selective use of vendors as supporting parties rather than primary service owners. The Executive Principal ensures infrastructure services are reliable, secure, compliant, and cost‑effective, while providing the operational foundation required for business continuity and growth. You will have Executive Accountability and be the single point of executive ownership for: Enterprise infrastructure availability, resilience, and operational stability End‑to‑end operations across all infrastructure domains Incident prevention, response, and service recovery Operational risk management, compliance, and audit readiness Infrastructure cost control, efficiency, and capacity planning Continuous improvement and modernization of run practices Enterprise Infrastructure Operations Ownership Own and operate all core infrastructure services, including data center, network, cloud/ hybrid, platform, and workplace operations. Ensure 24x7x365 operational reliability, service continuity, and disaster recovery readiness. Serve as the executive escalation authority for major incidents, systemic failures, and enterprise outages. Define and enforce clear operational accountability across internal infrastructure teams. Service Management & Operational Excellence Establish and enforce enterprise standards for IT Service Management (ITSM) including incident, problem, change, and escalation management. Reduce chronic incidents through root cause remediation, trend analysis, and elimination of recurring failures. Ensure service reporting is accurate, actionable, and aligned to executive and business expectations. Drive predictable service performance through disciplined run processes and operational rigor. Infrastructure Reliability & Risk Management Own enterprise infrastructure availability, resiliency, and fault tolerance strategies. Ensure infrastructure operations meet security, compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements. Partner with Security and Risk functions to address operational vulnerabilities and control gaps. Ensure DR, backup, and recovery capabilities are tested, documented, and effective. Vendor & Technology Oversight ( Supporting Role) Oversee infrastructure vendors and partners as supporting contributors, not primary service owners. Ensure vendors integrate cleanly into internal operating models, toolsets, and processes. Maintain accountability for vendor performance without transferring ownership of outcomes. Support sourcing decisions, renewals, and performance reviews where external services are required. Continuous Improvement & Modernization Drive continuous improvement across infrastructure operations through automation, tooling optimization, and process maturity. Partner with Architecture and Platform Engineering teams to transition new capabilities into stable run operations. Ensure modernization initiatives do not compromise operational stability or service reliability. Champion operational efficiency, simplification, and technical debt reduction. Leadership & Organizational Alignment Lead and develop senior infrastructure operations leaders across domains. Establish clear separation and collaboration between Core (Engineering) and Core & Non-Core (Operations) functions. Provide executive‑level transparency into service health, risk exposure, and operational priorities. Build confidence with Director Infrastructure and executive leadership through predictable and mature operations. What we require from you : 15+ years of senior IT infrastructure leadership experience with direct operational accountability. Proven leadership of large‑scale, multi‑domain infrastructure operations. Deep expertise in data center, network, cloud/hybrid platforms, workplace, and service management. Strong experience operating in high‑availability, regulated, or mission‑critical environments. Demonstrated ability to lead through operational complexity and organizational scale. Preferred Qualifications ITIL v4 or equivalent operational framework experience. Strong background in hybrid infrastructure environments. Experience leading infrastructure operations in enterprise or global organizations. Financial acumen related to infrastructure cost management and optimization. Measures of Success Sustained achievement of infrastructure availability and reliability targets Reduction in major incidents, outages, and repeat failures Improved service predictability and operational maturity Strong audit and compliance outcomes High executive confidence in infrastructure operations Base Salary Range: $190,000 to $220,000 Our Company adheres to the equal employment opportunity guidelines set forth by federal, state and local laws. review_candidates.description: Ruolo : Space System Engineer - Aerospace Luog o: Milano ALTEN supporta le strategie di sviluppo dei propri clienti nelle aree dell’innovazione, della R&D e dei sistemi informativi tecnologici. Nato più di 30 anni fa e presente in 30 Paesi, il Gruppo ALTEN si è affermato come leader mondiale nell’ingegneria e nei Servizi IT e leader Europeo per la consulenza nell'industria Life Sciences. Lavoriamo con attori chiave nei settori: Aeronautico &Spaziale, della Difesa & Navale, della Sicurezza, Automobilistico, Ferroviario, dell’Energia, del Life Sciences, Finanziario, del Retail e dei Servizi. Con un fatturato di oltre 4.069 miliardi di euro, abbiamo attualmente più di 57.400 collaboratori in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo presenti in 13 città lungo tutto il territorio nazionale: Torino, Milano, Gallarate, Brescia, Genova, La Spezia, Modena, Maranello, Bologna, Firenze, Roma, Napoli e Bari Di cosa ti occuperai: Responsabilità della progettazione del sottosistema della missione; Analisi e definizione requisiti per sistemi spaziali; Supporto la campagna di test di integrazione e qualità; Interfacciarsi con i team di ingegneria interni, i clienti, i fornitori e le strutture di prova per supportare l'esecuzione delle attività di verifica e validazione. Requisiti: Laurea Triennale/Magistrale in Ingegneria dell'Automazione/Robotica/Aerospazio/Elettronica Esperienza pregressa di almeno 3 anni nel medesimo ruolo; Conoscenza normative ECSS,MIL; Conoscenza di base dell'elettronica e sviluppo SW; Modalità di lavoro ibrida. " La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 35.000 EUR e 44.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato da ALTEN. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna." "Il ruolo prevede l’integrazione dei principi di sicurezza delle informazioni nelle attività quotidiane, con attenzione alle policy aziendali. Include la gestione sicura di credenziali e strumenti, l’identificazione dei rischi e la segnalazione di incidenti. Verrà fornito il supporto necessario per consolidare queste competenze." Perché scegliere ALTEN? Technological challenges Crediamo che la tecnologia abbia un grande potenziale per migliorare il nostro futuro, per questo ricerchiamo talenti che siano motivati a costruire oggi il mondo di domani. Con il nostro portfolio clienti e i diversi progetti di R&D attivi, in ALTEN avrai modo di lavorare su progetti all'avanguardia. La nostra Technical Direction ti accompagnerà e indirizzerà durante il tuo percorso. Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi e di confrontarti con esperti del settore per ampliare sempre più le tue conoscenze. Potrai unire le tue passioni e metterti in gioco professionalmente. Accetti la sfida? Inspiring Togetherness Ci impegniamo a favorire un ambiente di lavoro sereno e collaborativo organizzando attività di team building, iniziative di aggregazionee, eventi sportivi, per conoscerci meglio e condividere momenti insieme. Il successo di un gruppo si fonda sulla cooperazione e condivisione reciproca del sapere e degli interessi. Fulfilling Opportunities In ALTEN troverai corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze sia tecnologiche, sia linguistiche! Tramite ALTEN Academy potrai ottenere certificazioni con alcuni dei più importanti schemi internazionali come IREB®, ISTQB® e altri. Attraverso Aula Streaming, invece, avrai accesso a corsi di formazione più trasversali relativi a soft skills e potrai scegliere tra 12 corsi di lingua straniera. Sustainable commitment Crediamo che la tecnologia sia a supporto dello sviluppo sociale e della tutela ambientale. Oltre a collaborare a progetti che mirano alla sostenibilità, ci impegniamo a sostenere le cause che più abbiamo a cuore, avendo collaborato e collaborando, tra gli altri, con AISM, AIRC, LILT, Save the Children, Treedom, This Unique. Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità all'interno della nostra azienda, fornendo loro gli strumenti per esprimere al massimo il proprio potenziale. Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti di crescita personale e aziendale più ampi. Promuoviamo l'inserimento e l'integrazione lavorativa delle persone appartenenti alle categorie protette - in base a quanto disciplinato dalla legge 68/99. I prossimi step Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv, ci prenderemo il tempo necessario per valutarlo attentamente. Se sarà in linea con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, il nostro team Talent Acquisition ti contatterà telefonicamente. L’iter di selezione proseguirà con un colloquio conoscitivo con l'area Business, un successivo colloquio più approfondito, durante il quale potrebbe essere richiesto un test pratico, ed infine un colloquio tecnico. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di selezione. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro gestionale per poterlo rivalutare per opportunità future. Operando in 13 diverse città e altrettanti settori, potrebbero contattarti più Talent Acquisition Partner e/o più Business Manager, se riterranno che il tuo profilo sia in linea con i progetti e le necessità che stanno ricercando in quel momento. Se dovessi identificare ulteriori offerte di tuo interesse e in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente ALTEN opera nel rispetto dei principi di diversità, equità ed inclusione, che alimentano i nostri valori. ALTEN ha l’obiettivo di abbattere ogni barriera e pregiudizio, garantendo un ambiente di lavoro accessibile ed accogliente, valutando candidature indipendentemente da genere, etnia, disabilità (artt. 1 e 18, legge 68/99), età, orientamento sessuale, religione, stato civile, convinzioni personali e politiche, appartenenza ad organizzazioni sindacali, responsabilità familiari e back-ground socio-economico.

review_candidates.title: Technical Leader - NOC
review_candidates.description: NOC Technical Leader   The Technical Lead role should help us build a team that can handle more complexity and scale without increasing in size proportionally and without becoming reliant on a few technical experts.   How would it be like to work as a NOC Technical Lead with us?  Your main mission will be to help increase the team's technical capability, autonomy, and scalability in collaboration with the NOC Manager.  You’ll be a technical point of reference for your colleagues and support them in handling complex incidents and troubleshooting activities in areas like routing, switching, VPN, VoIP, DNS, cloud, and other IT&C services – technologies that are already part of the team’s area of responsibility.  You’ll serve as the technical escalation point for situations that exceed the team’s autonomy level and contribute to identifying and implementing technical solutions.  Your role will go beyond solving individual incidents: you’ll look to identify recurring problems, understand their causes, and help implement solutions that reduce the likelihood of the same issues happening again. The Technical Lead will work closely with the NOC Manager, contributing to the development of the team's technical capabilities, managing complex situations, and continuously improving technical processes and practices. Technical leadership You will: • be a technical reference point and escalation point for complex situations; • guide troubleshooting and root cause analysis for high-impact or recurring incidents; • support the team in making technical decisions; • identify risks, recurring issues, and areas for improvement, and help implement corrective actions; • collaborate with other technical teams to solve problems requiring cross-functional expertise; • contribute to defining and improving technical standards, troubleshooting methodologies, and operational best practices; • provide technical recommendations to the NOC Manager when a problem impacts operations, resources, services, or customers; • help assess the technical impact of proposed changes and solutions.   Scaling & Continuous Improvement An important part of your role will be to help the team handle a larger volume and level of complexity, without this automatically meaning a proportional increase in resources. You will: • identify repetitive activities and automation opportunities; • simplify and improve processes and troubleshooting workflows; • contribute to developing procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation; • turn individual knowledge into reusable knowledge for the whole team; • analyze patterns in incidents and escalations to identify systemic issues; • suggest improvements to tools and processes that can reduce resolution time and manual tasks; • help define and track relevant technical metrics; • monitor the increase in the percentage of issues resolved independently by the team; • collaborate with the NOC Manager to prioritize and implement improvement initiatives that impact NOC operations. Your success won't just be measured by how many complex problems you manage to solve, but more importantly by how many problems the team becomes capable of solving without depending on you.   Mentorship & team development You'll have an active role in developing your colleagues' technical skills. You will: • mentor colleagues on day-to-day technical challenges; • use complex incidents as coaching and learning opportunities, without automatically taking over their resolution; • provide structured technical feedback and help colleagues identify their areas for growth; • organize knowledge sharing sessions, technical deep-dives, and incident reviews; • contribute to onboarding new colleagues and accelerating their technical development; • identify knowledge gaps within the team and help define training plans; • encourage colleagues to progressively take ownership of increasingly complex situations; • help build an environment were asking questions, sharing experiences, and learning from incidents are part of the normal workflow; • give the NOC Manager technical input regarding team members' competence levels and development areas. This component builds on the approach already present in the team, where curiosity, the ability to learn new technologies, creativity, and taking responsibility are expected behaviors.    Knowledge & Operational Excellence  You will help build a team where knowledge is accessible and not just concentrated in a few key people.  You will:  • help maintain and improve technical documentation, procedures, and troubleshooting guides;  • make sure that lessons learned from major incidents are documented and shared;  • promote consistent troubleshooting and incident management practices;  • contribute to post-incident reviews and turn conclusions into concrete actions;  • help define technical quality standards within the team. What makes you stand out? • Solid technical experience in networking and/or IT&C environments, CCNP Certification-nice to have . • Relevant troubleshooting experience in technologies such as routing, switching, VPN, DNS, VoIP, cloud, or similar areas. • Experience managing complex incidents and performing root cause analysis. • Ability to understand complex technical problems and explain them clearly and in a structured way. • Ownership and the ability to make decisions in complex situations. • Genuine interest in mentoring and developing other colleagues. • Ability to provide constructive feedback and adjust your approach according to colleagues' experience levels. • Focus on continuous improvement, automation, and operational efficiency. • Ability to spot patterns and move from solving individual incidents to addressing systemic problems. • Excellent collaboration and communication skills. • Advanced-level English.   How do we picture you? You are a professional with solid technical experience, who enjoys solving complex problems, but understands that technical leadership doesn’t just mean being the person who has all the answers. You like helping others grow, sharing your experience, and building, together with the NOC Manager, an environment where colleagues become increasingly autonomous and confident in their technical decisions. Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer (Rust) - remote in the EU
review_candidates.description: Company Description About Mirantis Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Societe Generale, Splunk, and Volkswagen. Learn more at www.mirantis.com . Job Description About the Team Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work. We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with understanding of Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset. Core Responsibilities Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go. Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas. Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms. Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems. Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms or systems programming Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and proficiency in Go (secondary). Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline. APIs & Serialization: gRPC/Protobuf contract design (via tonic/prost) and schema evolution (using zero-copy serialization and compile-time type generation). Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns. Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external service dependencies. Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews. Desired: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client). DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs). High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2. Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services). Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus. Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation. Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware). Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices. Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC. Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM. Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns. Demonstrated participation or maintaining open-source systems projects Additional information What does Mirantis offer you? - Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry; - Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies; - Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation; - Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued; - Professional development and training; - Attend conferences and working groups; - Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks; - Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan. It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

review_candidates.title: Technical Product Manager, Platform
review_candidates.description: Our Mission: At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost. Our Vision: We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future. The Role: Platform is the core part of what makes Sunrise succeed: the software that lets a robotic cell see, move and recover, and the simulation pipeline we use to build and test all of it. You will own it. You will own what Platform builds and why: which problems it solves next, what done means, and when it lands. This is not a backlog administration job. The engineers you will work with have strong, well argued technical opinions. You need the robotics depth to argue back with evidence, to challenge an estimate credibly, and to judge when the elegant architecture is worth the time and when it is not. The same judgement runs toward the customer: what Platform builds becomes the capabilities that decide which processes we can automate and which markets we can enter, so every technical trade-off is also a customer value decision. What you’ll do Own the Platform roadmap Run discovery and prioritisation: turn ideas from customers, engineers and leadership into evidenced, prioritised jobs to be done. Turn prioritised jobs to be done into initiatives: write the specs, set milestones the team can commit to, and sequence them against the Sunrise roadmap. In robot software the cost of change is the core problem: a wrong requirement costs months, not days. Work out how much specification each decision needs, and catch the expensive mistakes before anyone builds them. Run delivery with engineering Run cycle planning for the pillar, name the outcome of each cycle, and check that the planned work adds up to that outcome. Track dates against milestones with each initiative's technical lead. When estimates and targets disagree, cut scope, add people or move the date, explicitly and early. Sign off that delivered work meets the requirements and the quality bar written in the spec. Be the technical counterpart Work daily with team leads and senior engineers on real trade-offs: perception accuracy against cycle time, simulation fidelity against speed, ship now against build it properly. Challenge estimates and accept challenge back. Arguments here run on evidence, not seniority. Carry the customer into the platform Our customers are high-mix manufacturers, and the people who matter most are operators and facility managers. Bring their reality into every prioritisation decision. Work with the deployment team so what Platform ships works on a customer's factory floor, not just in the lab. What you’ll need: A robotics engineering background. You have built and shipped robot software (perception, motion planning, manipulation or robotics simulation) as an engineer or technical lead. This is a must. The role cannot be done from product experience alone. Senior product experience. You have owned a technical product area with 10 or more engineers and carried it from problem to shipped, including the messy middle. Spec writing where the cost of change is high. Specs and requirements that engineers respect and that hold up months later. Estimation and delivery discipline. Milestones, estimates with stated risk, and honest reforecasting when the numbers disagree. Argument by evidence. You can disagree with a very senior engineer and change their mind, or have yours changed, without the relationship taking damage. Excellent written English. We are remote and run on documents, not slides. A working grasp of learned robotics. ML-driven perception and control alongside classical methods, enough to weigh bets between them. What Makes You Stand Out: Industrial automation or manufacturing experience in high-mix environments. Hands-on time with simulation tooling such as Isaac Sim. Experience as the first or most senior product person in a technical area, defining the ways of working rather than inheriting them. Serious daily use of AI tools in product work.

review_candidates.title: Junior Producer / Studio Manager (m/w/d) – Fokus Förderung & Operations
review_candidates.description: Standort: Vollständig Remote (wir sind ein Münchner Studio), Wohnsitz in Bayern ist vorteilhaft Art der Stelle: Vollzeit / Teilzeit (nach Absprache) Über uns: Servus, wir sind Active Fungus Studios – ein ca. 20-köpfiges Indie-Entwickler:innenstudio aus München und das Team hinter Prospera , Medieval Frontiers und der "Inspector Schmidt" -Reihe. Wir entwickeln Games, die Spaß machen, aber auch zum Nachdenken anregen, und legen Wert darauf, dass wichtige Entscheidungen gemeinsam getroffen werden, Ideen von allen zählen und der Umgang miteinander entspannt und auf Augenhöhe ist.  Warum wir dich suchen: Unser Studio wächst, und die Aufgaben auf dem Schreibtisch unserer Geschäftsführung platzen aus allen Nähten. Zwischen Game Design, Community Management, Finanzen und Teamführung bleibt die administrative Produktion oft als mentaler Kraftakt übrig. Hier kommst du ins Spiel! Wir suchen eine strukturierte rechte Hand für die Geschäftsführung – eine Person, die keine Angst vor Bürokratie und Excel-Listen hat, die Fäden im Hintergrund zusammenhält und uns den Rücken freihält, damit wir uns wieder mehr auf die kreative Vision unserer Spiele konzentrieren können. Du gestaltest das Spielerlebnis mit: Als Teil des Producer-Teams testest du unsere Spiele in jeder Entwicklungsphase, identifizierst UX-Hürden und hilfst durch dein Feedback aktiv mit, das Spiel besser zu machen. Du musst kein Lead-Designer sein – dein frischer Blick auf den aktuellen Build und dein Gespür für den Game-Flow sind genau das, was wir brauchen.  Deine Aufgaben (Hier entlastest du uns am meisten): Fokus Förderung (Grants): Du bist unser Motor für Förderanträge. Du übernimmst das Verfassen von Antragsprosa, das Zusammenstellen von Pitch-Dokumenten und den Aufbau von Finanztabellen (in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung). Struktur: Du behältst Fristen im Blick und erstellst Zwischenberichte sowie Verwendungsnachweise. Wir halten den Doku-Aufwand bewusst minimal: Dokumentiert wird nur das, was Prozesse wirklich erfordern – und das fokussiert, klar und ohne unnötigen Ballast.  Operative Produktion: Du unterstützt beim Sprint-Tracking, der Meilensteinplanung und stellst sicher, dass Deadlines realistisch gesetzt und eingehalten werden. Hands-on Playtesting & UX-Feedback: Du spielst unsere neuesten Builds regelmäßig selbst an und bist ganz nah am Entwicklungsprozess. Dabei gibst du dem Team wertvolles, konstruktives Feedback zu Spielgefühl, Usability (UX) und Verständlichkeit. Dieses tiefe Produktverständnis ist nicht nur extrem wertvoll für das Team, sondern bildet gleichzeitig das perfekte Fundament für deine Förderanträge, Sachberichte und Pitch-Dokumente.  Team-Organisation: Du hilfst bei den alltäglichen Team-Check-ins, hast ein offenes Ohr für das Team und übernimmst kleinere organisatorische Extraprojekte. Dein Profil (Was du mitbringst): Hervorragendes Deutsch (in Wort und Schrift): Das ist ein absolutes Muss, denn Behörden und Förderinstitutionen lieben präzise, fehlerfreie und gut formulierte Texte. Struktur & Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Arbeitsanweisungen, sondern siehst, wo Dinge getan werden müssen, und packst sie an. Du kannst dich selbst strukturieren, denkst lösungsorientiert mit und hast eine echte Hands-on-Mentalität. Wo Chaos ist, bringst du Ordnung rein. Zahlenverständnis: Du hast keine Panik vor Excel/Google Sheets, Budgets und Kalkulationen. Hintergrund: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Media Management, Games Business, Produktion ODER du bist eine extrem gut organisierte, quereinsteigende Person (z.B. aus dem IT-, Kultur- oder Projektmanagement-Bereich). Kommunikation: Du bist empathisch, hast gute Laune und Freude daran, im Team zu arbeiten. Was wir dir bieten: Echten Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bist ein essenzieller Teil dafür, dass unsere Projekte überhaupt erst realisiert werden können. Steile Lernkurve: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bekommst tiefe Einblicke in das Business eines Indie-Studios. Flexibilität: Die Möglichkeit, vollständig remote aus dem Homeoffice zu arbeiten (wir arbeiten mit Open Project, Discord und Google). Echte Vertrauenskultur: Ein Team, das auf offene Kommunikation setzt, Erfolge gemeinsam feiert und in dem deine Stimme echtes Gewicht hat.  Gehalt: 34.000 € – 40.000 € brutto/Jahr (auf Vollzeitbasis, Anpassung bei Teilzeit möglich) – je nach Vorerfahrung.  Wie wir ticken Active Fungus Studios ist ein kooperatives Unternehmen . Unsere Basis sind Selbstverantwortung, Solidarität, Demokratie und Fairness . Wir stehen für Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion. Diskriminierende oder menschenfeindliche Ideologien haben bei uns keinen Platz. Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam nach dem Konsent Prinzip Wichtige Rollen (z. B. Vorstand, Gehaltsrat) werden gewählt Wir setzen auf Selbstorganisation und Vertrauen Gewinn als gemeinschaftlicher Erfolg . Wir haben das Prinzip der universellen Gewinnbeteiligung fest verankert. Gewinne werden gerecht und nachvollziehbar nach transparenten Regeln an alle Mitarbeitenden ausgeschüttet. Der Erfolg des Unternehmens ist direkt und unmittelbar der Erfolg jeder einzelnen Person im Team. Konflikte sind unvermeidlich, feindseliges Verhalten ist es nicht. Wir streiten leidenschaftlich für die besten Lösungen, aber niemals gegeneinander. Bring dein ganzes Selbst mit. Wir sind Menschen, keine Maschinen. Emotionen, Bedürfnisse und ehrliche Kommunikation haben bei uns einen hohen Stellenwert. Wir wissen, dass es ein Privileg ist, in der Spieleentwicklung arbeiten zu können – und gleichzeitig eine Arbeit, von der man fair und verlässlich leben können muss. Unsere Arbeit dient der finanziellen Absicherung und der kreativen Selbstverwirklichung gleichermaßen – in Projekten, die wir mit Leidenschaft verfolgen und verantwortungsvoll gestalten. Klingt nach genau deinem Ding? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, aussagekräftiges Anschreiben (in dem du uns gern erzählst, warum du die richtige Person für das Förder- und Orga-Chaos bist) an: info@activefungus-studios.de Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht!
