review_candidates.title: Hightech Assemblagemonteur EUV | ASML | €4.000 - €4.500
review_candidates.description: Functieomschrijving Wil Jij Niet Zomaar Machines Assembleren, Maar Werken Aan Technologie Waarmee De Meest Geavanceerde Chips Ter Wereld Worden Geproduceerd? Als Hightech Assemblagemonteur Bij ASML In Veldhoven Bouw Je Mee Aan Complexe EUV-systemen. Je Werkt Met Mechanische, Elektrische En Mechatronische Onderdelen En Zorgt Ervoor Dat Iedere Component Precies Op De Juiste Plek Terechtkomt. Dit Is Een Functie Voor Een Technisch Sterke Monteur Die Nauwkeurig Werkt, Technische Tekeningen Begrijpt En Energie Krijgt Van Complexe Techniek. Je Houdt Je Onder Andere Bezig Met Assembleren en opbouwen van technische modules en machinecabines; Monteren van mechanische, elektrische en mechatronische componenten; Aanleggen, aansluiten en zorgvuldig wegwerken van kabels, slangen en kabelgoten; Werken volgens technische tekeningen, werkinstructies en montageprocedures; Controleren of onderdelen correct zijn gemonteerd en gepositioneerd; Uitvoeren van controles en signaleren van afwijkingen; Nauwkeurig registreren van je werkzaamheden; Samenwerken met technicians, engineers en andere technische specialisten. Je werkt aan een product waar precisie geen detail is, maar een vereiste. Wat jij vandaag bouwt, vormt de basis voor de volgende stap in de assemblage van een EUV-systeem. Functie-eisen Jij Bent Succesvol In Deze Rol Als Je een afgeronde mbo-3 of mbo-4 opleiding hebt in bijvoorbeeld Mechatronica, Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare technische richting; Je ervaring hebt met assemblage, machinebouw, mechatronica of technische productie; Je technische tekeningen en werkinstructies kunt lezen en begrijpen; Je ervaring hebt met het monteren van kabels, componenten, modules of complete machineonderdelen; Je nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werkt; Je zelfstandig kunt werken, maar ook goed samenwerkt binnen een technisch team; Je technisch inzicht hebt en problemen niet zomaar laat liggen; Je de Engelse taal goed beheerst. Nederlands is voor deze functie niet noodzakelijk; Je jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen binnen een hightech omgeving. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Wat Krijg Je Terug Voor Jouw Werkzaamdheden Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.000 tot €4.500, afhankelijk van je ervaring Een fulltime functie van 40 uur per week Ploegentoeslag indien van toepassing 27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen 8% vakantiegeld Een 13e maand, afhankelijk van de toepasselijke arbeidsvoorwaarden Een goede pensioenregeling Reiskostenvergoeding Een uitgebreid onboarding- en trainingsprogramma Praktische begeleiding bij het leren kennen van het product en de werkwijze Begeleiding door ervaren technicians en technische specialisten Mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen assemblage, productie en testing Een internationale werkomgeving waarin Engels de voertaal is. Info over het bedrijf ASML is een gerenommeerd hightech bedrijf dat zijn oorsprong vindt in 1984 als een dochteronderneming van Philips. Als wereldleider op het gebied van lithografiemachines speelt ASML een cruciale rol in de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde technologieën. Deze machines worden wereldwijd ingezet door vooraanstaande bedrijven zoals Samsung en Intel om chips te produceren voor diverse digitale toepassingen, waaronder smartphones, tablets en gps-systemen. Met zijn voortdurende focus op kennis en innovatie fungeert ASML als een drijvende kracht achter de vooruitgang in de technische sector. Elke dag wordt er gewerkt aan het creëren van een betere, efficiëntere en schonere toekomst. Bij ASML kom je terecht in een gezonde en mensgerichte werkomgeving, waar je de mogelijkheid krijgt om je ambities waar te maken. Het bedrijf biedt een stimulerende omgeving waarin talent wordt gewaardeerd en gestimuleerd.

Monitor and analyze network availability and performance, recommending optimizations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration between network infrastructure and other systems. Develop and maintain network infrastructure documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and procedures. Evaluate new networking technologies and make adoption recommendations. Provide training and guidance to other team members. Provide on-call support outside regular working hours. Candidate Profile: University degree, preferably in a technical, IT, or related field. Advanced English, written and spoken. Minimum 4 years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-level network infrastructure. Experience designing and implementing complex networks using Cisco, Fortinet, Citrix, Checkpoint, and other relevant technologies. Solid knowledge of networking technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, QoS, VRF, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, STP, VPN, IPSEC, HSRP, VRRP, LACP). Relevant certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Citrix Certified Expert - Networking (CCE-N), etc. are an advantage. Knowledge of Linux is an advantage. Hands-on experience with network monitoring, diagnostic, and analysis tools (SNMP-based monitoring, NetFlow, Nagios, Zabbix). Experience with network automation and scripting using tools such as Ansible or PowerShell is an advantage. Public cloud knowledge (Microsoft Azure, AWS) is an advantage. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams. Strong communication skills, able to engage effectively with the team, clients, and colleagues from other departments. High level of energy and enthusiasm to approach projects and team collaboration with a proactive, positive attitude. Benefits: Competitive net salary package. International work environment. Continuous professional and technical development. Private health care package. Lunch tickets. new_matches.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Infrastructure Specialist (Europe/Middle East)
new_matches.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About North North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications. Why This Role? This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Our esteemed clients include industry leaders like RBC, Dell, and LG CNS. We are seeking engineers who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI. In This Role, You Will Lead end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout. Partner with enterprise IT teams to assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices. Experiment at a high velocity and with a high level of quality to engage our customers and ultimately deliver solutions that exceed their expectations Design and implement deployment strategies tailored to client needs, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security standards. Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related technical issues, providing timely solutions to minimize downtime. You May Be a Good Fit If You have experience with and enjoy working directly with customers You have experience deploying enterprise software in private/hybrid cloud environments You have proven experience administering production Kubernetes clusters and expertise with Helm Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Git for version control You have strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), networking, and virtualization You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How And Where We Work Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

Proposer et accompagner la mise en oeuvre d'évolutions technologiques et organisationnelles. Contribuer à la réduction de la dette technique et à l'optimisation des ressources. Veiller au respect des standards de sécurité, des règles de gouvernance et des politiques de la DSI sur l'ensemble du périmètre réseau. Indicateurs de performance (KPIs) La performance du poste sera notamment évaluée au regard des indicateurs suivants : Disponibilité et stabilité : taux de disponibilité du réseau et respect des SLA. Intégrer SYS TELECOMS c’est rejoindre une société qui a la conviction, que c’est en donnant les moyens et en accompagnant les individus, qu’ils peuvent exprimer leurs pleins potentiels. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents chaque jour auprès de nos collaborateurs et auprès de nos clients pour relever de nouveaux défis.

new_matches.title: Junior IT Administrator, EMEA
new_matches.description: About Dash0 Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in. Dash0 is an OpenTelemetry-native observability platform growing fast, and the infrastructure that keeps our team operational needs to be as reliable as the product we build. As our Junior IT Administrator, you'll own the full device and access lifecycle — from a new hire's first laptop to an employee's final offboarding — and build the systems that make it repeatable at scale. This role exists because we've outgrown ad-hoc IT. We need someone who takes genuine ownership: provisioning accounts, enforcing endpoint security, maintaining audit-ready records, and keeping our SaaS stack under control. You'll work closely with our Head of Security and People Ops team, but the systems work is yours to run. It's a foundational role with real scope. The processes you put in place today will scale with the company for years. What You'll Do Provision and de-provision accounts across our SaaS stack for every new hire and departure, keeping onboarding repeatable and offboarding complete. Manage the full device lifecycle: hardware ordering, MDM enrollment, international logistics, maintenance, and responsible recycling at end-of-life. Enforce endpoint security policies, including disk encryption, activation lock, and device compliance checks, coordinating with our Head of Security to keep standards current. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of who has access to what — catching and resolving discrepancies in serial numbers, license counts, and access logs before they become compliance issues. Execute end-to-end offboarding by revoking access across all systems, coordinating hardware retrieval, and ensuring nothing slips through. Manage vendor relationships and contracts for IT services and hardware insurance, including invoice auditing and service forecasting. Support employees across time zones with clear, prompt communication on IT issues, hardware needs, and access requests. What You Bring 0–2 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, or a technical helpdesk role. Hands-on comfort with device management tools and the Google Workspace admin console, including user and group management. A working understanding of endpoint security concepts — disk encryption, activation lock, device compliance policies, and why they matter in a security-conscious environment. Strong attention to detail: you notice when a serial number, license count, or access log doesn't add up, and you follow through until it does. Clear written English and ease coordinating across time zones with employees, vendors, and internal teams. new_matches.description: Ruolo : Space System Engineer - Aerospace Luog o: Milano ALTEN supporta le strategie di sviluppo dei propri clienti nelle aree dell’innovazione, della R&D e dei sistemi informativi tecnologici. Lavoriamo con attori chiave nei settori: Aeronautico &Spaziale, della Difesa & Navale, della Sicurezza, Automobilistico, Ferroviario, dell’Energia, del Life Sciences, Finanziario, del Retail e dei Servizi. Con un fatturato di oltre 4.069 miliardi di euro, abbiamo attualmente più di 57.400 collaboratori in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo presenti in 13 città lungo tutto il territorio nazionale: Torino, Milano, Gallarate, Brescia, Genova, La Spezia, Modena, Maranello, Bologna, Firenze, Roma, Napoli e Bari Di cosa ti occuperai: Responsabilità della progettazione del sottosistema della missione; Analisi e definizione requisiti per sistemi spaziali; Supporto la campagna di test di integrazione e qualità; Interfacciarsi con i team di ingegneria interni, i clienti, i fornitori e le strutture di prova per supportare l'esecuzione delle attività di verifica e validazione. Requisiti: Laurea Triennale/Magistrale in Ingegneria dell'Automazione/Robotica/Aerospazio/Elettronica Esperienza pregressa di almeno 3 anni nel medesimo ruolo; Conoscenza normative ECSS,MIL; Conoscenza di base dell'elettronica e sviluppo SW; Modalità di lavoro ibrida. " La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 35.000 EUR e 44.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato da ALTEN. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna." "Il ruolo prevede l’integrazione dei principi di sicurezza delle informazioni nelle attività quotidiane, con attenzione alle policy aziendali. Include la gestione sicura di credenziali e strumenti, l’identificazione dei rischi e la segnalazione di incidenti. Verrà fornito il supporto necessario per consolidare queste competenze." Perché scegliere ALTEN? Technological challenges Crediamo che la tecnologia abbia un grande potenziale per migliorare il nostro futuro, per questo ricerchiamo talenti che siano motivati a costruire oggi il mondo di domani. Con il nostro portfolio clienti e i diversi progetti di R&D attivi, in ALTEN avrai modo di lavorare su progetti all'avanguardia. La nostra Technical Direction ti accompagnerà e indirizzerà durante il tuo percorso. Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi e di confrontarti con esperti del settore per ampliare sempre più le tue conoscenze. Potrai unire le tue passioni e metterti in gioco professionalmente. Accetti la sfida? Inspiring Togetherness Ci impegniamo a favorire un ambiente di lavoro sereno e collaborativo organizzando attività di team building, iniziative di aggregazionee, eventi sportivi, per conoscerci meglio e condividere momenti insieme. Il successo di un gruppo si fonda sulla cooperazione e condivisione reciproca del sapere e degli interessi. Fulfilling Opportunities In ALTEN troverai corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze sia tecnologiche, sia linguistiche! Tramite ALTEN Academy potrai ottenere certificazioni con alcuni dei più importanti schemi internazionali come IREB®, ISTQB® e altri. Attraverso Aula Streaming, invece, avrai accesso a corsi di formazione più trasversali relativi a soft skills e potrai scegliere tra 12 corsi di lingua straniera. Sustainable commitment Crediamo che la tecnologia sia a supporto dello sviluppo sociale e della tutela ambientale. Oltre a collaborare a progetti che mirano alla sostenibilità, ci impegniamo a sostenere le cause che più abbiamo a cuore, avendo collaborato e collaborando, tra gli altri, con AISM, AIRC, LILT, Save the Children, Treedom, This Unique. Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità all'interno della nostra azienda, fornendo loro gli strumenti per esprimere al massimo il proprio potenziale. Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti di crescita personale e aziendale più ampi. Promuoviamo l'inserimento e l'integrazione lavorativa delle persone appartenenti alle categorie protette - in base a quanto disciplinato dalla legge 68/99. Se sarà in linea con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, il nostro team Talent Acquisition ti contatterà telefonicamente. L’iter di selezione proseguirà con un colloquio conoscitivo con l'area Business, un successivo colloquio più approfondito, durante il quale potrebbe essere richiesto un test pratico, ed infine un colloquio tecnico. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di selezione. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro gestionale per poterlo rivalutare per opportunità future. Operando in 13 diverse città e altrettanti settori, potrebbero contattarti più Talent Acquisition Partner e/o più Business Manager, se riterranno che il tuo profilo sia in linea con i progetti e le necessità che stanno ricercando in quel momento. new_matches.title: Technical Leader - NOC
new_matches.description: NOC Technical Leader   The Technical Lead role should help us build a team that can handle more complexity and scale without increasing in size proportionally and without becoming reliant on a few technical experts.   How would it be like to work as a NOC Technical Lead with us?  Your main mission will be to help increase the team's technical capability, autonomy, and scalability in collaboration with the NOC Manager.  You’ll be a technical point of reference for your colleagues and support them in handling complex incidents and troubleshooting activities in areas like routing, switching, VPN, VoIP, DNS, cloud, and other IT&C services – technologies that are already part of the team’s area of responsibility.  You’ll serve as the technical escalation point for situations that exceed the team’s autonomy level and contribute to identifying and implementing technical solutions.  Your role will go beyond solving individual incidents: you’ll look to identify recurring problems, understand their causes, and help implement solutions that reduce the likelihood of the same issues happening again. The Technical Lead will work closely with the NOC Manager, contributing to the development of the team's technical capabilities, managing complex situations, and continuously improving technical processes and practices. Technical leadership You will: • be a technical reference point and escalation point for complex situations; • guide troubleshooting and root cause analysis for high-impact or recurring incidents; • support the team in making technical decisions; • identify risks, recurring issues, and areas for improvement, and help implement corrective actions; • collaborate with other technical teams to solve problems requiring cross-functional expertise; • contribute to defining and improving technical standards, troubleshooting methodologies, and operational best practices; • provide technical recommendations to the NOC Manager when a problem impacts operations, resources, services, or customers; • help assess the technical impact of proposed changes and solutions.   Scaling & Continuous Improvement An important part of your role will be to help the team handle a larger volume and level of complexity, without this automatically meaning a proportional increase in resources. You will: • identify repetitive activities and automation opportunities; • simplify and improve processes and troubleshooting workflows; • contribute to developing procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation; • turn individual knowledge into reusable knowledge for the whole team; • analyze patterns in incidents and escalations to identify systemic issues; • suggest improvements to tools and processes that can reduce resolution time and manual tasks; • help define and track relevant technical metrics; • monitor the increase in the percentage of issues resolved independently by the team; • collaborate with the NOC Manager to prioritize and implement improvement initiatives that impact NOC operations. Your success won't just be measured by how many complex problems you manage to solve, but more importantly by how many problems the team becomes capable of solving without depending on you.   Mentorship & team development You'll have an active role in developing your colleagues' technical skills. You will: • mentor colleagues on day-to-day technical challenges; • use complex incidents as coaching and learning opportunities, without automatically taking over their resolution; • provide structured technical feedback and help colleagues identify their areas for growth; • organize knowledge sharing sessions, technical deep-dives, and incident reviews; • contribute to onboarding new colleagues and accelerating their technical development; • identify knowledge gaps within the team and help define training plans; • encourage colleagues to progressively take ownership of increasingly complex situations; • help build an environment were asking questions, sharing experiences, and learning from incidents are part of the normal workflow; • give the NOC Manager technical input regarding team members' competence levels and development areas. This component builds on the approach already present in the team, where curiosity, the ability to learn new technologies, creativity, and taking responsibility are expected behaviors.    Knowledge & Operational Excellence  You will help build a team where knowledge is accessible and not just concentrated in a few key people.  You will:  • help maintain and improve technical documentation, procedures, and troubleshooting guides;  • make sure that lessons learned from major incidents are documented and shared;  • promote consistent troubleshooting and incident management practices;  • contribute to post-incident reviews and turn conclusions into concrete actions;  • help define technical quality standards within the team. What makes you stand out? • Solid technical experience in networking and/or IT&C environments, CCNP Certification-nice to have . • Relevant troubleshooting experience in technologies such as routing, switching, VPN, DNS, VoIP, cloud, or similar areas. • Experience managing complex incidents and performing root cause analysis. • Ability to understand complex technical problems and explain them clearly and in a structured way. • Ownership and the ability to make decisions in complex situations. • Genuine interest in mentoring and developing other colleagues. • Ability to provide constructive feedback and adjust your approach according to colleagues' experience levels. • Focus on continuous improvement, automation, and operational efficiency. • Ability to spot patterns and move from solving individual incidents to addressing systemic problems. • Excellent collaboration and communication skills. • Advanced-level English.   How do we picture you? You are a professional with solid technical experience, who enjoys solving complex problems, but understands that technical leadership doesn’t just mean being the person who has all the answers. You like helping others grow, sharing your experience, and building, together with the NOC Manager, an environment where colleagues become increasingly autonomous and confident in their technical decisions. You feel comfortable taking technical ownership in complex situations and being an escalation point for the team when needed. At the same time, your goal is to help the team find the solution, not to become the person on whom solving every difficult problem depends. You understand that your role is one of technical leadership and enablement, complementing the role of the NOC Manager. You have a constant focus on scaling and efficiency: you look for ways to simplify processes, automate repetitive tasks, and turn individual experience into reusable knowledge across the whole team.  You combine technical expertise with good communication, coaching, and collaboration skills, and you can adapt the way you communicate depending on who you’re talking to – technical colleagues, other teams, management, or clients.  You’re curious, pragmatic, and always looking for opportunities to improve, both from a technical perspective and in how the team works.   What does success look like in this role? In the first 6–12 months, we would expect to see: • the team’s technical autonomy increasing; • fewer escalations that could be handled at the team level; • less dependence on specific key individuals; • improved quality and consistency in troubleshooting; • better technical documentation and knowledge that’s easier to reuse; • reduction of repetitive or manual work through automation and process improvement; • visible development of technical skills among junior and mid-level colleagues; • identifying and resolving the root causes of recurring issues, not just handling individual incidents; • a stronger culture of ownership, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.   What we offer: On the job training with our senior colleagues; Access to our WIKI and technical labs; Technical certifications covered by the company; Great opportunities for career development; Technical training; Easily accessible location; Private health insurance for you and your family; Wellbeing Programs; Flexible benefits budget; Employee Referral program; Hybrid work adapted to the current situation. Who we are: We are specialists in IT&C services based on state-of-the-art technologies. We began our journey in 1993 as the first company that provided internet services in Romania. We then contributed to the development of the IT&C market and that of the entire company. We are part of the Deutsche Telekom Group. Our customers are both local and international companies with high standards. We are honored to know that they trust us and so, we are always looking for ways to improve ourselves. We are in a constant search for clear, solid solutions that change with the customers’ needs. We are in a continuous process of innovation, but we only believe in the tested innovation. We create integrated solutions whenever integration is relevant to the customer. We value order: through it, we simplify the increasingly complex relationship that our customers' businesses have with the world of data and telecommunications. The company has approximately 150 employees and is based in Bucharest. Our values: Our company values serve as a compass for our actions and describe how we behave in the marketplace. They provide standards at every level of our business and are the ethical foundation for everything we do at GTS. We are committed to our customers For us it is essential to understand our customers' needs and develop innovative solutions which help them become a better business. We do as we say we are going to do Trust is earned. We follow our words with actions so everyone knows they can depend on us. Our people make the difference We are passionate and skilled. We have the courage to try new things, we dare. We work as a team to deliver services at the highest standards. We are proud of GTS

Assisting with infrastructure and technology projects, including deployments, upgrades and other site-based activities. Run delivery with engineering Run cycle planning for the pillar, name the outcome of each cycle, and check that the planned work adds up to that outcome. Milestones, estimates with stated risk, and honest reforecasting when the numbers disagree. Argument by evidence. You can disagree with a very senior engineer and change their mind, or have yours changed, without the relationship taking damage. Excellent written English. We are remote and run on documents, not slides. A working grasp of learned robotics. ML-driven perception and control alongside classical methods, enough to weigh bets between them. new_matches.title: Junior Producer / Studio Manager (m/w/d) – Fokus Förderung & Operations
new_matches.description: Standort: Vollständig Remote (wir sind ein Münchner Studio), Wohnsitz in Bayern ist vorteilhaft Art der Stelle: Vollzeit / Teilzeit (nach Absprache) Über uns: Servus, wir sind Active Fungus Studios – ein ca. 20-köpfiges Indie-Entwickler:innenstudio aus München und das Team hinter Prospera , Medieval Frontiers und der "Inspector Schmidt" -Reihe. Wir entwickeln Games, die Spaß machen, aber auch zum Nachdenken anregen, und legen Wert darauf, dass wichtige Entscheidungen gemeinsam getroffen werden, Ideen von allen zählen und der Umgang miteinander entspannt und auf Augenhöhe ist.  Warum wir dich suchen: Unser Studio wächst, und die Aufgaben auf dem Schreibtisch unserer Geschäftsführung platzen aus allen Nähten. Zwischen Game Design, Community Management, Finanzen und Teamführung bleibt die administrative Produktion oft als mentaler Kraftakt übrig. Hier kommst du ins Spiel! Wir suchen eine strukturierte rechte Hand für die Geschäftsführung – eine Person, die keine Angst vor Bürokratie und Excel-Listen hat, die Fäden im Hintergrund zusammenhält und uns den Rücken freihält, damit wir uns wieder mehr auf die kreative Vision unserer Spiele konzentrieren können. Du gestaltest das Spielerlebnis mit: Als Teil des Producer-Teams testest du unsere Spiele in jeder Entwicklungsphase, identifizierst UX-Hürden und hilfst durch dein Feedback aktiv mit, das Spiel besser zu machen. Du musst kein Lead-Designer sein – dein frischer Blick auf den aktuellen Build und dein Gespür für den Game-Flow sind genau das, was wir brauchen.  Deine Aufgaben (Hier entlastest du uns am meisten): Fokus Förderung (Grants): Du bist unser Motor für Förderanträge. Du übernimmst das Verfassen von Antragsprosa, das Zusammenstellen von Pitch-Dokumenten und den Aufbau von Finanztabellen (in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung). Struktur: Du behältst Fristen im Blick und erstellst Zwischenberichte sowie Verwendungsnachweise. Wir halten den Doku-Aufwand bewusst minimal: Dokumentiert wird nur das, was Prozesse wirklich erfordern – und das fokussiert, klar und ohne unnötigen Ballast.  Operative Produktion: Du unterstützt beim Sprint-Tracking, der Meilensteinplanung und stellst sicher, dass Deadlines realistisch gesetzt und eingehalten werden. Hands-on Playtesting & UX-Feedback: Du spielst unsere neuesten Builds regelmäßig selbst an und bist ganz nah am Entwicklungsprozess. Dabei gibst du dem Team wertvolles, konstruktives Feedback zu Spielgefühl, Usability (UX) und Verständlichkeit. Dieses tiefe Produktverständnis ist nicht nur extrem wertvoll für das Team, sondern bildet gleichzeitig das perfekte Fundament für deine Förderanträge, Sachberichte und Pitch-Dokumente.  Team-Organisation: Du hilfst bei den alltäglichen Team-Check-ins, hast ein offenes Ohr für das Team und übernimmst kleinere organisatorische Extraprojekte. Dein Profil (Was du mitbringst): Hervorragendes Deutsch (in Wort und Schrift): Das ist ein absolutes Muss, denn Behörden und Förderinstitutionen lieben präzise, fehlerfreie und gut formulierte Texte. Struktur & Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Arbeitsanweisungen, sondern siehst, wo Dinge getan werden müssen, und packst sie an. Du kannst dich selbst strukturieren, denkst lösungsorientiert mit und hast eine echte Hands-on-Mentalität. Wo Chaos ist, bringst du Ordnung rein. Zahlenverständnis: Du hast keine Panik vor Excel/Google Sheets, Budgets und Kalkulationen. Hintergrund: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Media Management, Games Business, Produktion ODER du bist eine extrem gut organisierte, quereinsteigende Person (z.B. aus dem IT-, Kultur- oder Projektmanagement-Bereich). Kommunikation: Du bist empathisch, hast gute Laune und Freude daran, im Team zu arbeiten. Was wir dir bieten: Echten Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bist ein essenzieller Teil dafür, dass unsere Projekte überhaupt erst realisiert werden können. Steile Lernkurve: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bekommst tiefe Einblicke in das Business eines Indie-Studios. Flexibilität: Die Möglichkeit, vollständig remote aus dem Homeoffice zu arbeiten (wir arbeiten mit Open Project, Discord und Google). Echte Vertrauenskultur: Ein Team, das auf offene Kommunikation setzt, Erfolge gemeinsam feiert und in dem deine Stimme echtes Gewicht hat.  Gehalt: 34.000 € – 40.000 € brutto/Jahr (auf Vollzeitbasis, Anpassung bei Teilzeit möglich) – je nach Vorerfahrung.  Wie wir ticken Active Fungus Studios ist ein kooperatives Unternehmen . Unsere Basis sind Selbstverantwortung, Solidarität, Demokratie und Fairness . Wir stehen für Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion. Diskriminierende oder menschenfeindliche Ideologien haben bei uns keinen Platz. Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam nach dem Konsent Prinzip Wichtige Rollen (z. B. Vorstand, Gehaltsrat) werden gewählt Wir setzen auf Selbstorganisation und Vertrauen Gewinn als gemeinschaftlicher Erfolg . Wir haben das Prinzip der universellen Gewinnbeteiligung fest verankert. Gewinne werden gerecht und nachvollziehbar nach transparenten Regeln an alle Mitarbeitenden ausgeschüttet. Der Erfolg des Unternehmens ist direkt und unmittelbar der Erfolg jeder einzelnen Person im Team. Konflikte sind unvermeidlich, feindseliges Verhalten ist es nicht. Wir streiten leidenschaftlich für die besten Lösungen, aber niemals gegeneinander. Bring dein ganzes Selbst mit. Wir sind Menschen, keine Maschinen.
